_note: ChillPops Jamaica detailed explainer. One line per detail, in tour order. gap = seconds of silence before the line. 'phone' and 'close' stay last.

lines.say: This is the new Chill Pops Jamaica website. It opens like a movie, with a few seconds of their own footage, then the site rises in.
Warm sparks drift up through the hero, like the filament bulbs hanging in the shop.
Their soft serve plays inside a paleta shaped frame, with a neon light running around it. Move the mouse, and it tilts.
Every Plan your visit button opens one simple menu: directions to Negril or Ocho Rios, Instagram, Facebook, or email.
As you scroll, the menu bar turns solid, and a pink line along its edge shows how far down you are.
The welcome section uses their own photos, with the word paletas traced softly behind, drifting as you scroll.
Look closely, and a palm frond shadow sways across the page, like afternoon sun.
This pink ribbon races along as you scroll, changes direction when you scroll back up, and pauses when you hover.
Each photo opens like a curtain. Hover a card, and it tilts toward you while a short description slides up.
Featured flavours float gently, and anything made with alcohol carries a clear label.
This photo band drifts with a gentle parallax, and the headline grows as it reaches the middle.
Pick your vibe: fruity, creamy, or spiked. A pill slides to your choice, and the pops fan out in its colour.
In the gallery, captions slide up as you hover, and the soft serve tile is a video.
Open one, and it fills the screen, with a counter and arrows to step through.
Find us shows the Boardwalk address, a plus code, and directions. Hours and phone appear here once they're confirmed.
The footer signs off with cool down, island style, and the Chill Pops name stretched edge to edge, with a slow shine.
Click the logo, and the page glides back to the top.
The Flavours page lists the flavours Chill Pops has featured. Type mango, and it filters instantly, with a live count.
Or tap a filter, like contains alcohol, to see only the spiked pops.
Search for something they don't make, and a friendly message offers to clear the search.
Each name sits on a dotted leader, like a printed menu, ending in where that flavour was featured.
Our Story tells how Damir Tufail opened in Negril in September 2020, with chairs and tables he built himself.
Locations shows both shops, Negril and Ocho Rios, each with its own directions.
And on a phone, the menu slides in from the side, and a directions button follows you down the page.
Fast, mobile friendly, and built to bring tourists to the counter. Website by Steven Scale Solutions.
